_about: Vendor reads for chain carousel v12's new purchased parts, 2026-11-27. McMaster: family/category tables and the part panels, logged out, in a headed Chromium (Playwright over CDP, Xvfb) whose traffic left through the doser Pi (SOCKS5; the exit network checked as BYU's), throttled to 400 kB/s, real pointer moves and wheel scrolls, pauses between pages. No bot check or block was shown; product-detail pages were not opened (they need a login). Prices are McMaster's list prices that day.

spring_cradle.how: McMaster family table and the part's panel (part number clicked in the table row), logged out, headed Chromium through the doser Pi (SOCKS5), throttled to 400 kB/s
spring_cradle.method: Every row of McMaster's metric 'Compression Springs' table (995 rows) and inch table (1,125 rows) was read by scrolling the table, plus the inch precision (139) and mil. spec. (114) tables and the metric precision table (36, all 9 mm OD or more). Kept: OD <= 6.3 mm, ID >= 3.3 mm, free length 15-24 mm, then ranked on rate, free length and whether the compressed length at max. load reaches 9.4 mm. Forces are rate x (free length - installed length) from the listed rate.

best.why: Closest on every count and rated through the 9.4 mm up-stop; spring steel, not stainless.

best_stainless.why: No stainless spring matches both 1.0 N/mm and 19 mm free. 8969T506 (316, 1.02 N/mm, 17 mm) stays inside its rating through the up-stop at 4.1 N preload; 8969T507 (316, 0.89 N/mm, 19 mm) gives 5.3 N preload but is 0.9 mm past its max-load length at the up-stop. 2006N257 (302) is rated through the travel but 29 % stiff.

others_considered.why_not: music-wire steel, 0.813 in (20.65 mm) free, 0.88 N/mm, 0.24 in OD, rated to 7.42 mm: 6.7 N at the stop; $4.58 per 5. A cheaper non-stainless alternative.
302 stainless, 0.813 in free, 0.77 N/mm (23 % soft), rated only to 10.59 mm (the up-stop is 1.2 mm past it).
316 stainless, 18.5 mm free, 5.63 OD, 1.25 N/mm, rated only to 10.9 mm.
302 stainless, 0.75 in free, 0.24 in OD, 0.86 N/mm, but rated only to 13.46 mm (1 lb max).
